name: Draconic for Dummies
summary: Narain Soothfancy remembers a book he stowed somewhere safe. To reach it you look for his crashed gyrocopter on Land's End Beach, then swim south from there to an island in the South Seas. This follows Translating the Ledger.

sections.title: A Book Stowed Away
sections.body: Narain Soothfancy says the book is bound to come in handy, and that he hid it where nobody could hope to find it. He needed a gyrocopter to get there the first time and crashed it on the beach on the way back. That crash, he says, gave him his super-gnomish psychic powers. The wreck lies somewhere along Land's End Beach, and from there you swim south. Narain is sure you will recognise the place at a glance. The island where the book lies buried is out in the South Seas.

sections.title: At the Island
sections.body: On the island you find a mound of dirt, and the book is gone. A note lies on top of the mound in its place.

faq.q: Who sends you to find this book?
faq.answer: Narain Soothfancy sends you after the book, once you have finished Translating the Ledger for him.

faq.q: Where did Narain crash his gyrocopter?
faq.answer: Narain says he crashed it on a beach on his way back from hiding the book. You will find the wreck somewhere on Land's End Beach.

faq.q: Where is the book supposed to be hidden?
faq.answer: Narain Soothfancy says it lies buried on an island out in the South Seas. You swim south from the wreck on Land's End Beach, and he says the spot will be plain when you see it.

faq.q: How did Narain get his psychic powers?
faq.answer: Narain says the gyrocopter crash on the beach gave him his psychic powers.
